headline: Public hearing on appeal of approval for vinyl privacy and picket fence at 65 Green Acres Drive.
summary: Case ZAP-26-15, filed by Soren & Meghan Dews and Katherine Coakley, appeals administrative approval ZPF-26-80. The property is in the RL zone, Ward 4.
items: Public hearing: ZAP-26-15, appeal of administrative approval ZPF-26-80 for vinyl privacy fence and picket fence at 65 Green Acres Drive (RL, Ward 4), Soren & Meghan Dews / Katherine Coakley

Appeal of administrative approval of ZPF-26-80 for installation of vinyl privacy fence and picket fence.   
2. Informational and Non-Discrimination Statements 
  
   
2.1. Participation in the DRB proceeding is a prerequisite to the right to take any subsequent appeal. Please note that 
ANYTHING submitted to the Zoning office is considered public and cannot be kept confidential. This may not be the final 
order in which items will be heard. Please view final Agenda, at https://burlingtonvt.portal.civicclerk.com/ or the office 
notice board, one week before the hearing for the order in which items will be heard.
